ValidationRule.description: When Type is Equipment, Equipment Description must be filled in and at least one Equipment record must be linked to move past Internal Review (Submitted and beyond).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( CASE(StageName, "Submitted", 1, "Approved", 1, "Pre Docs", 1, "Docs Requested", 1, "Docs Out", 1, "Funding Request Sent", 1, "Funded", 1, "FPC", 1, 0) = 1, ISPICKVAL(Type, "Equipment"), OR( ISBLANK(Equipment__c), Equipment_Count__c = 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Equipment Description must be filled in and at least one Equipment record must be linked to submit an Equipment deal.
